title: Backup
description: Create an encrypted backup of all data and files, or restore one.

export.downloadStarted: The download has started. Check that the file was saved completely.
export.downloadManual: If the download does not start by itself, use the button.
export.linkOnce: The link works only once and for 15 minutes. Keep the file and the backup password separately and safely.
export.scopesDescription: Choose what to back up. Dependent areas are included automatically.
export.includeFilesHint: Uploaded files (receipts, images, documents) of the chosen areas. Without files the backup is smaller, but the contents will be missing when restoring.
export.passwordDescription: The backup file is encrypted with this password.
export.keepSafeText: Without this password the backup cannot be restored. File + password give access to all data including credentials.
export.creatingHint: With many files this can take a few minutes. Please keep the page open.
export.chooseScope: Please choose at least one area.
export.confirmDescription: Confirm with your account password{twoFactor, select, yes { and the code from your authenticator app} other {}}. {count} {count, plural, one {area} other {areas}} will be backed up{files, select, yes { including files} other { without files}}.

modes.restoreText: The chosen areas are completely replaced by the state in the backup.
modes.mergeText: Only missing records are added. Existing data stays unchanged.

import.uploadIncomplete: The upload is incomplete. Please try again.
import.summaryRestore: {count} {count, plural, one {area is} other {areas are}} replaced by the state in the backup. Current data in these areas will be lost.
import.summaryMerge: Only missing records from the backup are added in {count} {count, plural, one {area} other {areas}}. Existing data stays unchanged.
import.runningHint: Please do not close the page. The system is briefly unavailable meanwhile.
import.loggedOutText: Your session was ended. Sign in again – with the credentials from the backup if your account was taken from it.
import.scopesTaken: {count} {count, plural, one {area was} other {areas were}} taken over.
import.rolledBack: The changes were rolled back as far as the server could report.
import.quietTime: Restore preferably at a quiet time.
import.quietTimeText: Background jobs pause during the run. Changes others make meanwhile may be replaced by the state in the backup.
import.step1Text: Choose a file created with “Create backup” ({ext}).
import.step2Text: The backup password decrypts the file; with your account password{twoFactor, select, yes { and the code} other {}} you confirm the operation.
import.step3Text: Valid until {until}. Choose mode and areas.
import.otherKeyText: The backup comes from a server with a different key. Encrypted values are re-encrypted and check values recalculated; anything that cannot be recalculated is reported in the result.
import.takeSmtpHint: Use the SMTP settings from the backup instead of the current ones.
import.moduleStateHint: Enable or disable modules as they were when the backup was made.
import.accountSame: Your account is in the backup with the same password.
import.accountKept: Your current account is kept as well so you do not lock yourself out.
import.willLogout: You will be signed out afterwards and sign in again with the credentials from the backup.
import.twoFactorInBackup: Two-factor sign-in is active for your account in the backup – have the authenticator app from back then ready.
import.missingUserRefs: {count} {count, plural, one {reference} other {references}} to users that do not exist on the target. These entries will then show as “Unknown”.
